title: Stalkee
subtitle: It is immoral to stalk others, and we all know that.

items.text: Stalkee

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Hello, this is Sonetto, the chief assistant of the Foundation's Timekeeper. My employee number is SF38000000801102Y. Could you please register a visit to Ward 1525 for me?

items.speaker: Receptionist
items.text: Please present your ID.

items.speaker: Receptionist
items.text: Hold that crystal with your right hand until the color changes.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: O-okay.

items.speaker: Receptionist
items.text: What is the shape of the sun, a sphere or a cube?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: A sphere.

items.speaker: Receptionist
items.text: Which is edible, rubber, cabbage, or Carbuncle?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Cabbage.

items.speaker: Receptionist
items.text: Does the rain come down from the sky or the other way around?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... Can be both.

items.speaker: Receptionist
items.text: You're good to go.

items.speaker: Receptionist
items.text: Take these materials with you. The Visitor Guide is between the second page and third page. Go in from the left, turn right twice, and take the lift. Keep walking, and you will see the ward.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I see. Thank you. Is there anything else I should know?

items.speaker: Receptionist
items.text: Just leave the number out next time.

items.speaker: Receptionist
items.text: Will you?
The receptionist disappears once again behind the counter.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The nurses seem busy here.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The registration is also more rigorous than it was before. I wonder if this is because of the "Storm" ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Turn right again ... hm? But there is only one way and it goes left.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Did I miss any crossings?
Sonetto looks back over her shoulder. A shadow swiftly disappears around the corner.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What's that?
She goes to the corner. There's only a machine with a shaking console.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Maybe I'm seeing things.
The buildings of Laplace Scientific Computing Center have been cleverly designed.
A crossing is hidden in this corner.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Hm? So here is the junction to the right ...
Sonetto walks to the junction and disappears into the light.
Behind her, one of the doors in the hallway opens. A shadow follows her into the light.
Footsteps. Sometimes near, sometimes far.
It follows Sonetto.
Speeding up ...
It speeds up.
Slowing down ...
It slows down as well.
Well then ...
Let's go faster, and faster.
Until the shoes are about to be lifted out from the ground, and even the ankles are starting to hurt. Go quickly, and more quickly, qui ...
... And now, run!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Phew ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Press every button here to buy some time ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Who was that? Could be a disoriented patient ... or a Manus's spy? Or ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I can't get away from "it."

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: And I will not bring danger to the Timekeeper.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I will catch this person.
The elevator stops at the 15th floor. It's rather empty and spacious here.
One can only hear Sonetto's footsteps, aside from the evergoing automatic broadcasts in the building.

items.speaker: Broadcast
items.text: The rehabilitation Center is established to provide effective medical services and trainings to the patients, for their bodily functions to be restored.

items.speaker: Broadcast
items.text: This center is managed by Laplace Scientific Computing Center; if you have any special requirements or have encountered any suspicious persons, please move to the ground floor lobby for help.

items.speaker: Broadcast
items.text: If you are distant from the lobby, please press the yellow button next to the fire hose cabinets. The security on your floor will come to assist shortly.
The footsteps appear again.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: They're here.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I don't see any cabinets ... That's fine.

items.speaker: Broadcast
items.text: If no help or assistance has come to you in time, you may take action to defend yourself. A free wake-up procedure will be administered on any unresponsive persons if any.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Good, just what I need.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: The sanitary trolley is parked at the next turn. I've left the biggest garbage bag on it.
She suddenly speeds up and quickly turns into the corner.
The unknown follower becomes anxious and runs to the corner ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Hey ...!
Whoaa ...!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Who are you? Speak up ...! Why are you following me?
Aww ...
The follower refuses to respond. It clutches the bag to cover its face and tries desperately to escape.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Stop! You're not getting away!
The bag is struggling with all efforts. This is a battle of dignity.
Sonetto feels it is slipping away from her grasp, so she pulls out her wand ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Whoever you are ... May the peace be with us!
TO BE CONTINUED…
